data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
# Blueberry Scones

A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

## Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream.
8. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

## Tips
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes

data.content:
Classic Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 20 minutes | Cook Time: 15 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Yields 8 scones. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones

A delightful, buttery scone recipe with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
  2. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
  3. Cut cold butter into small pieces and mix into dry ingredients until crumbly.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Combine wet and dry ingredients, fold in blueberries gently.
  6. Shape into a circle on a baking sheet, cut into wedges.
  7. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

Enjoy warm with clotted cream or jam!

### **Ingredients**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar

- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter (cold, cubed)  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  
- 1/2 cup heavy cream  
- 1 large egg  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  

---

### **Instructions**
1. Preheat oven to **400°F (200°C)**. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.  
3. Cut in cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  
4. Fold in blueberries.  
5. Whisk cream, egg, and vanilla in a separate bowl.  
6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until combined.  
7. Shape dough into a 7-inch circle on a floured surface, cut into 8 wedges.  
8. Place on the baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and bake for **15–18 minutes** until golden.  
9. Cool on a wire rack before serving.  

---

### **Notes**
- Best served **warm** with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 7-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden.
  9. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Notes

Best served warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones

A delightful, buttery scone recipe bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or tea time.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, pat into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-22 minutes until golden.

Enjoy warm with clotted cream or jam!

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Code & Cuisine
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe
A delightful, buttery scone bursting with fresh blueberries, perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries (or frozen, unthawed)
- 2/3 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle, about 1-inch thick.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.

Serving Suggestion:
Serve warm with clotted cream and jam.

Published: 2025-08-15
Category: Baking, Breakfast
Tags: scones, blueberries, easy recipes

- Cranberry Orange Scones
- Classic Buttermilk Biscuits

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Ingredients

  • 1/2 tsp salt

  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.

  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones

This recipe yields light, tender scones bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for a weekend brunch.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment.
  2. Whisk dry ingredients: flour, sugar, baking powder, salt.
  3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Mix wet into dry until just combined.
  7. Pat into a 1-inch thick circle on baking sheet. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Bake 15-18 minutes until golden. Cool slightly before serving.

Enjoy with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
# Blueberry Scones

A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

## Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream.
8. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

## Tips
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

data.content:
Classic Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 20 minutes | Cook Time: 15 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Yields 8 scones. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
